edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner from the deployer, establishing the initial privileged role.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable during construction.
setAdminByOwner requires msg.sender == owner before setting admin.
The _admin parameter is stored into the admin state variable.
setAdminByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin before rotating the admin.
setOwnerByAdmin requires msg.sender == admin before transferring ownership.
The admin can overwrite the owner state variable via setOwnerByAdmin.
kill executes selfdestruct on the contract.
selfdestruct forwards the contract balance to the owner address.
setAuthorized is guarded by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.
setOwner is gated by the auth modifier which calls isAuthorized.
setAuthority is gated by the auth modifier which calls isAuthorized.
isAuthorized evaluates the caller address against owner/authority.
isAuthorized delegates to authority.canCall when a guard is configured.
The authorization result decides whether setOwner may mutate owner.
The authorization result decides whether setAuthority may mutate authority.
The owner_ parameter becomes the new privileged owner.
The authority_ parameter becomes the new authorization backend.
givePermission can install a freshly created DSGuard as the proxy authority.
givePermission uses the hardcoded FACTORY_ADDRESS to mint a new guard.
The _contractAddr parameter is granted execute permission on the proxy.
currAuthority reads the proxy's current authority to decide guard creation.
The guard local is used to permit the target contract.
removePermission forbids execute permission through the proxy authority guard.
callExecute forwards value and data into the user DSProxy execute.
onlyMonitor compares the caller against the monitor state variable.
msg.sender must equal monitor for callExecute to proceed.
changeMonitor records the request time to gate later confirmation.
block.timestamp (now) is persisted in changeRequestedTimestamp.
The _newMonitor parameter is stored as the pending monitor.
confirmNewMonitor promotes newMonitor into the monitor state variable.
block.timestamp is compared against the change request to enforce the delay.
CHANGE_PERIOD scales the timestamp gate for confirming a new monitor.
revertMonitor writes lastMonitor back into the monitor state variable.
onlyAllowed consults the allowed mapping to gate monitor administration.
msg.sender is looked up in the allowed mapping for privileged monitor functions.
addAllowed writes privileged addresses into the allowed mapping.
setChangePeriod overwrites the CHANGE_PERIOD governing monitor rotation.
callProxy marks the user nonce as used after signature verification.
The nonce mapping is read back to reject replay of signed meta-transactions.
The digest derived from user, proxy, contract, data and nonce is verified with ecrecover.
onlyAuthorized requires msg.sender to be an authorized relayer.
callProxy performs an arbitrary external execute call on the target user proxy.
The _user parameter must equal the proxy owner and the recovered signer.
setServiceFee is restricted to the Discount owner.
The owner check compares msg.sender to Discount.owner.
The _fee parameter is written into the caller's serviceFees entry.
setBot toggles entries in the botList mapping that governs fee tiers.
botList(tx.origin) selects the cheaper automatic service fee.
tx.origin is used as the key for the bot registry lookup in AaveHelper.getFee.
tx.origin is used as the key for the bot registry lookup in MCDSaverProxy.getFee.
The bot list mapping is consulted before applying the fee tier.
getFee forwards the computed fee to the protocol wallet.
The WALLET_ADDR constant is used as the transfer recipient for fees.
sendFullContractBalance computes the full balance and calls sendContractBalance.
calcGasCost bounds tx.gasprice with the owner-controlled MAX_GAS_PRICE.
The gasPrice local is derived from tx.gasprice and used in the gas cost product.
Gas reimbursement is added onto the service fee, scaling the amount pulled from the user.
MCDSaverProxy.getFee transfers the calculated fee to WALLET_ID.
The 0x fee refund is sent to tx.origin rather than msg.sender.
Leftover ETH after repay/boost is refunded via tx.origin.transfer.
withdrawToken is restricted by onlyOwner comparing msg.sender to owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner_ parameter exists only to be written into the owner state variable through setOwner.
The authority_ parameter exists only to be stored as the authority state variable.
The _admin parameter is used solely to initialize the admin state variable.
The _user parameter is only used as the key when updating the authorized mapping.
The _contractAddr parameter is only used to grant DSGuard execute permission.
The _newMonitor parameter is only stored as the pending newMonitor value.
The _data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the user DSProxy execute call.
The _user parameter is only used for the proxy owner and ecrecover identity checks.
The _fee parameter is only written into the per-user serviceFees entry.
The _gasAmount parameter is only multiplied with the bounded gas price.
currAuthority is a transient local holding the proxy authority used to branch guard creation.
The guard local only exists to call permit/forbid on the DSGuard.
The gasPrice local captures tx.gasprice capped by MAX_GAS_PRICE for the cost product.
The digest local is only used for ecrecover signature validation.
